description: Parallax PING))) ultrasonic distance sensor: 3 pins (GND, 5V, SIG). One signal pin both starts a ping and returns the echo.
how_to_use: GND to GND, 5V to 5V, SIG to one digital pin. The sketch sets SIG as OUTPUT to send a 5 µs trigger pulse, then as INPUT and times the echo pulse with pulseIn(); the pulse length is the round-trip time of the sound (29 µs per cm).

pins.SIG: signal: trigger out, echo back on the same pin

plain.what: Measures distance with sound too high to hear — it pings and listens for the echo, like a bat.
plain.how: GND to GND, 5V to 5V, and SIG to a digital pin. The same SIG wire sends the ping and hears the echo.
